title: Access control in code: always check on the server

videos.script: A receptionist opens the staff console. There is no link to clinical notes on her screen. {{hidden}} So the notes are protected. Or are they? The link is hidden. The address still answers. {{answers}} A page is a suggestion to an honest browser. Anything can send a request: a script, a terminal, a browser with the form edited. {{anything}} So every decision about who may do what is made on the server, from what the server knows. Never from a field the request carries. {{server}} And when somebody adds a route next month and forgets the check, a test notices before anybody else does. {{test}} Today the console learns all three. {{today}}
